title: Under certain conditions, privilege manager agent allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute… (CVE-2026-92744)
description: CVE-2026-92744 is a high-severity vulnerability in a privilege manager agent that under certain conditions allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code with LocalSystem privileges. The vulnerability has a CVSS 4.0 base score of 8.7, indicating significant impact. No affected versions or patch information are provided, and no known exploits are reported in the wild.
